### TYPING,AMR,VF and BUSCO RESULTS {.tabset .tabset-pills}
```{r, results='asis',echo=FALSE}

  samplelist <- read.csv(params$csv,header=FALSE,sep = ',')[-1,]
  sampleid <- samplelist[,c(1)]
  for (i in sampleid){

    cat("\n")
    cat("####", i, "\n")

    rmlst_id <- (paste(i,"_speciesid.txt",sep=""))
    rmlst_file <- readLines(rmlst_id)
    # Display the content
    cat("```\n")
    cat(rmlst_file, sep = "\n")
    cat("\n```\n")

    sero_id <- (paste(i,"_serotype.tsv",sep=""))
    sero_raw <- read.csv(sero_id,header = TRUE,sep = "\t")
    sero_final<- sero_raw[,c(1,6,10,11,15)]
    colnames(sero_final) <- c("SAMPLE","GENE","%COVERAGE","%IDENTITY","SEROTYPE")
    print(knitr::kable(sero_final,align='lcccl',caption = "Serotype - \n Predicted using ABRicate (https://github.com/tseemann/abricate] with builtin and custom databases"))
    cat("\n")

    mlst_id <- (paste(i,"_MLST.tsv",sep=""))
    mlst_raw <- read.csv(mlst_id,header = TRUE,sep = "\t",fill = TRUE,check.names = FALSE)
    print(knitr::kable(mlst_raw,align= 'lcccccc',caption = "MLST - Predicted using https://pubmlst.org/ and MLST tool (https://github.com/tseemann/mlst)"))
    cat("\n")
  
    vf_id <- (paste(i,"_vf.tsv",sep=""))
    vf_raw <- read.csv(vf_id,header = TRUE,sep="\t")
    vf_final <- vf_raw[,c(1,6,10,11,15)]
    colnames(vf_final) <- c("SAMPLE","GENE","%COVERAGE","%IDENTITY","VIRULENCE FACTOR")
    print(knitr::kable(vf_final,align= 'lcccl',caption = "Virulence factors - \n Predicted using ABRicate (https://github.com/tseemann/abricate] with builtin and custom databases"))
    cat("\n")

    amr_id <- (paste(i,"_AMR.tsv",sep=""))
    amr_raw <- read.csv( amr_id,header = TRUE,sep="\t")
    amr_final <- amr_raw[,c(1,6,10,11,15)]
    colnames(amr_final) <- c("SAMPLE","GENE","%COVERAGE","%IDENTITY","AMR GENE")
    print(knitr::kable(amr_final,align= 'lcccl',caption = "AMR - \n Predicted based using ABRicate and CARD database (https://card.mcmaster.ca/)"))
    cat("\n")

    
    busco_id <- (paste(i,"_busco.txt",sep=""))
    busco_file <- readLines(busco_id)
    # Display the content
    cat("```\n")
    cat(busco_file, sep = "\n")
    cat("\n```\n")

    format_length <- function(x) {
      x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
      if (is.na(x)) return("N/A")
      if (x >= 1e9) paste(round(x / 1e9, 2), "Gb")
      else if (x >= 1e6) paste(round(x / 1e6, 2), "Mb")
      else if (x >= 1e3) paste(round(x / 1e3, 2), "Kb")
      else paste(x, "bp")
    }

    flye_file <- paste0(i, "_flye-info.txt")
    summ_file <- paste0(i, "_summary.tsv")

    if (file.exists(flye_file)) {
      flyeinfo_raw   <- read.csv(flye_file, header=TRUE, sep="\t")
      flyeinfo_final <- flyeinfo_raw[, c(1,2,3,4)]
      colnames(flyeinfo_final) <- c("SEQUENCE", "LENGTH", "COVERAGE", "IS_CIRCULAR")
      flyeinfo_final$LENGTH <- sapply(flyeinfo_final$LENGTH, format_length)
      print(knitr::kable(flyeinfo_final, align='llll',
        caption="Assembly statistics - \n Generated using flye assembler within dragonflye (https://github.com/rpetit3/dragonflye)"))
    } else if (file.exists(summ_file)) {
      summ_raw  <- read.csv(summ_file, header=TRUE, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE)
      sel_cols  <- if (ncol(summ_raw) >= 17) c(1,2,3,4,5,17) else seq_len(min(5, ncol(summ_raw)))
      summ_final <- summ_raw[, sel_cols, drop=FALSE]
      summ_final[[2]] <- sapply(summ_final[[2]], format_length)
      print(knitr::kable(summ_final,
        caption="Assembly statistics - \n Generated using Autocycler (https://github.com/rrwick/Autocycler)"))
    }
    


    }


```
